Its summary notes mu>mu_R for two omega-intervals in coeff-3 normalization, but does not identify M(Q) as dynamical scattering threshold, does not rescale to coeff-1 (sqrt(3) factor), does not flip phase convention (e^{-i omega t} vs e^{+i omega t}), and does not verify global H1 flow / L6 divergence / loop bound. Combination requires external dispersive input (1D GN optimizer/Weinstein-Kwong-Dodson threshold + graph LWP) absent from that paper. Not mechanical transcription: scaling, threshold identification, phase choice, Kirchhoff-preservation, and L6/loop verification are a cross-literature synthesis, not a textbook substitution. 1412.8232: cubic tadpole bifurcations via Lyapunov-Schmidt, subcritical stability only; no quintic, no virial gap, no above-threshold dynamics. 2502.21200: log-NLS single-lobe via splitting-eigenvalue Morse index; different nonlinearity and method. 2212.06411: BELOW-threshold scattering/blow-up dichotomy on Kirchhoff/repulsive-delta STAR via symmetric-decomposition profile analysis; complementary regime and disjoint topology (no loop). 1908.07122: star-delta virial for strong instability by blow-up; different topology (no loop circulation) and coupling. 1710.01178: subcritical shifted-state indices on stars. ArXiv searches for tadpole scattering/profile-decomposition/virial returned no hits per admission (consistent with our fetches). No prior states or mechanically implies an above-threshold loop-trapped non-scattering quintic tadpole flow. Stationary exceedance alone does not state the dynamical headline; L6/loop conclusions, while short, were never stated and require threshold rescaling + flow identification.
